title: Ten Seasons and One Broken Chain
subtitle: 生态循环 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 生态循环（人与自然·生态系统与循环）
meta: 主题语境：生态循环（人与自然·生态系统与循环）　|　核心词汇：cycle　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 cycle 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 my grandfather ① rode a cycle that no rider in the county would have borrowed, and he said the riding was the whole of the journey. The ② cycle, meaning the machine and not the season, ran ten seasons and stayed unrepaired in the shed; a cycle, he said, is the only thing in a shed that is judged by how long it is left unused.

Every ③ cycle in that shed had the same broken chain against it, and the ④ cycle at the end, meaning the one he kept for the harvest and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever borrowed twice. A cycle, my grandmother said, is nine parts repair and one part somebody willing to ride; my grandfather said the riding is the part that fills ten seasons.

The farmer meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the cycle was the whole of the year, meaning the season and not the machine. The ⑥ cycle, meaning the season and not any of that, is the only thing in a year that everybody plants by and nobody controls; cycle, he said, is either something you ride or the only word that means both a machine and a season. He said the season is the part they remember.

By 1960 the ⑦ cycle had become a line in a farm diary, and the diary had become an argument about the broken chain. The ⑧ cycle of the whole thing, my grandfather wrote in September, was one shed and ten seasons of riding; cycle, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to ride. She said the riding was never mentioned.

The ⑨ cycle I remember is the one at the end, which was last ridden in 1971 and is still described as the oldest in the county. A ⑩ cycle, my grandmother said in 1973, is the only thing that improves by being ridden; every cycle, she said, is a season that has agreed to look like a machine. She said the season was the honest half.

answers.why: ride a cycle 意为“骑一辆自行车”，1953 年祖父骑了一辆全县没有一位骑车人肯借的自行车。
cycle 意为“自行车”，指那台机器本身而不是那个季节，它在棚里搁了十个季节没有修。
cycle 意为“自行车”，指那个棚里每一辆自行车，每一辆都挂着同一条断链子。
cycle 意为“自行车”，指留给收租用、只在收获时骑的那一辆，是唯一有人借过两次的。
cycle 意为“循环、周期”，指一年的农时轮转，农夫说这个周期就是那一年的全部。
cycle 意为“周期”，指人人依循却无法控制的那一段轮回而不是别的，是一年里人人都照着种、却无人能掌控的东西。
cycle 意为“自行车”，指农事日记里写到、被记下的那一辆，到 1960 年这辆车成了日记里的一行。
cycle 意为“循环、周期”，祖父九月写道，整件事的循环是一个棚子与十个季节的骑行。
cycle 意为“自行车”，我记得的是末尾那一辆，1971 年最后一次被骑，至今仍被说成全县最旧的。
cycle 为抽象总称，祖母 1973 年说，一辆自行车是唯一会因为被骑而变得更好的东西。
